# Airpoints Store

> > Redeem Airpoints Dollars for premium products across fashion, beauty, home, travel, wine, food and more through Air New Zealand's loyalty rewards shopping platform.

Airpoints Store is Air New Zealand's dedicated rewards shopping destination, allowing customers to redeem accumulated Airpoints Dollars across a curated catalog of lifestyle products from both international and New Zealand brands. The platform features exclusive partnerships with premium retailers and local artisans across multiple product categories.

## Key Topics

- Airpoints Dollars
- Airpoints Rewards

## Shopping Categories

- [Airpoints Store Homepage](https://www.airpointsstore.co.nz): Air New Zealand's Airpoints Store homepage for rewards shopping across fashion, beauty, home and more
- [New Products](https://www.airpointsstore.co.nz/new): New products section featuring latest items redeemable with Airpoints Dollars
- [Womenswear](https://www.airpointsstore.co.nz/womens): Womenswear clothing and fashion products redeemable with Airpoints rewards
- [Childrenswear](https://www.airpointsstore.co.nz/children): Children's clothing and merchandise available through Airpoints loyalty program
- [Beauty & Fragrances](https://www.airpointsstore.co.nz/beauty): Beauty, cosmetics and skincare products redeemable with Airpoints Dollars
- [Fragrances](https://www.airpointsstore.co.nz/beauty/fragrances): Fragrances and perfumes redeemable with Airpoints Dollars rewards
- [Home & Tech](https://www.airpointsstore.co.nz/home-and-tech): Home and technology products redeemable with Airpoints Dollars loyalty rewards
- [Home Appliances](https://www.airpointsstore.co.nz/home-and-tech/home-appliances): Home appliances and household products redeemable with Airpoints rewards
- [Kitchen Appliances](https://www.airpointsstore.co.nz/home-and-tech/home-appliances/kitchen-appliances): Kitchen appliances available for Airpoints Dollars redemption
- [Travel Gear & Accessories](https://www.airpointsstore.co.nz/travel): Travel gear and accessories available for Airpoints Dollars redemption
- [Outdoor & Sports](https://www.airpointsstore.co.nz/outdoors-and-sports): Outdoor and sports gear available for Airpoints Dollars redemption
- [Wine, Spirits & Food](https://www.airpointsstore.co.nz/wine-and-food): Wine, spirits, craft beer and gourmet food available for Airpoints redemption

## Special Collections

- [New Zealand Brands](https://www.airpointsstore.co.nz/new-zealand-brands): New Zealand brands and products available through Airpoints loyalty rewards
- [Vouchers & Hampers](https://www.airpointsstore.co.nz/vouchers-and-hampers): Vouchers, gift cards and hampers from brand partners redeemable with Airpoints
- [Deals](https://www.airpointsstore.co.nz/deals): Discounted and special offer products redeemable with Airpoints rewards
